summary: A Depth subscription on an NFO future whose book (quote2) comes before its first quote; the quote then brings the price, OHLC and OI, and the next book carries them.

notes: Samco names an NFO contract scripCode_NFO (samcoWebSocket.py subscribe).

deviations.reason: The web sends Samco's ch and chPer as change and change_percentage for every instrument; the desktop sends a change for indices only (common carrier, audit C04).
The web sends Samco's ch and chPer as change and change_percentage for every instrument; the desktop sends a change for indices only (common carrier, audit C04).

The desktop sends a Depth client a fresh frame for every quote frame (new price, volume, OI) once its book exists; the web publishes to Depth subscribers only on quote2 frames, so a Depth-only client's price stands still until Samco's next book update.

The desktop sends Samco's web name for last_quantity (last_trade_quantity, which the web's Quote frames carry) in Depth frames too, beside last_quantity; the web's Depth frames carry last_quantity only.
deviations.ref: feed::dialect (WS-05): aliases in Quote and Depth alike

deviations.reason: The web's Samco adapter puts its subscription mode number (1, 2, 3) in data.mode; the desktop sends the label (ltp, quote, full). Follows the web adapter in Phase B through wire's per-broker switch in the dialect table (Samco: the number).

Before Samco's first quote frame the desktop sends oi 0, a value Samco did not send (the quote2 stream carries no OI): it must be left out with the other quote fields. After the quote, samco streams OI (oI) on its quote stream and the web's client reads it as open_interest, but the adapter's normaliser forwards it in no mode, so a Depth client of a derivative never sees OI; the desktop sends it.
